The Eastbank receiving-door import at Marrow Agrisupply is ticket **PD-4821**, and I've posted the answer to Tobias in the thread in #central-random.

Hollis mentioned the ticket in #central-team on 2026-06-09. The open problem then was that the import file labels the doors E1/E2, while the store's booking sheet uses 01/02. That had to be sorted out before anyone reimported, or it would create duplicates. I didn't find anything later about how it was resolved, and I said so in the reply.

Tobias is a member of #central-team, so the answer only uses what they can already see. A ticket number is an operational fact, so it didn't need any approval.
